issue.summary: In the Teamily iOS app (TestFlight build 386), after @-mentioning a member in a group chat and sending the message, the mention is NOT rendered in the message bubble — the bubble shows the text without the @ mention (no mention styling, no mentioned name). The conversation-list preview for the very same message DOES render the mention correctly, which proves the mention data is intact in the message payload and only the in-chat bubble rendering layer drops it. This breaks a core IM capability: recipients of the bubble cannot tell who was mentioned, and the sender cannot visually confirm that the mention was actually sent.
steps: Launch the Teamily iOS app on TestFlight build 386 (mobile client).
Compose a message and @-mention a group member (e.g. a message ending with @Henry).
Observe the sent message bubble: the @-mention is not rendered — the bubble shows plain text with no @ mention and no mention styling.
Return to the conversation list and observe the preview of the same message: the @-mention IS rendered correctly (e.g. "2点在压测吗? @Henry").
issue.expected: The sent message bubble should render the @-mention with mention styling and the mentioned member display name, consistent with the conversation-list preview and with the Web/Desktop client behaviour.
issue.actual: The message bubble renders the message text without the @-mention (mention not displayed, no mention styling). The conversation-list preview of the same message renders the mention correctly ("2点在压测吗? @Henry"), demonstrating that the mention exists in the message data and that only the in-conversation bubble rendering fails.
issue.context:
- **Feature area**: Messaging / UI Rendering (mention rendering)
- Reporter: Jane (Teamily PM/QA). Reported 2026-09-21.
- Evidence: the conversation-list preview renders the mention correctly while the in-chat bubble does not — the defect is isolated to the message bubble rendering layer, not to mention parsing, message payload or delivery.
- Impact: @ is a core IM capability. Users cannot see who was mentioned in a sent message, and cannot verify the mention was delivered, which can cause missed assignments/notifications in work groups.
- Regression window: only observed on the mobile client (iOS TestFlight 386); Web/Desktop renders mentions correctly.

---
issue.environment: - **Platform / OS / Browser**: iOS / Teamily mobile app / TestFlight build 386
